project_name: <set by Phase 0 — should match the worktree suffix>

count_params.command: <command that prints {trainable_params, total_params} JSON to stdout>

launch_experiment.command: <command that submits a job and prints the job ID to stdout>

read_metrics.command: <command that prints {final_train_loss, final_val_loss, ...} JSON to stdout, given $JOB_ID env var>

constraints: no change to random seed, validation dataset, validation logic, or validation metrics
no change to the experiment budget defined in config.json (experiment_budget)
no change to core dependencies / package versions
